title: Validate and enhance T4H portfolio control surface, then execute via bridge
summary: The T4H portfolio should be treated as a live ecosystem control surface, not a static brochure. It must explain the businesses, expose runtime/project health, connect canonical registry data, and make the business graph usable by humans, agents, commercial workflows, and downstream governance.

why_built: Make 30-50+ businesses understandable from one surface.
Replace static project lists with a live ecosystem map.
Give investors, partners, staff, agents, and customers a coherent view of what exists.
Create an operational registry surface linked to deployment status, canonical mappings, project pages, APIs, and automation.
Move from brochure to command/control surface for portfolio reality.
core_use_cases: Portfolio governance and canonical project registry
Launch coordination and remediation queue source
validated_intent.problem_statement: Current portfolio/project pages are visually weak, hard to understand, static, and not consistently connected to runtime evidence. The enhanced system should explain what all businesses are, show live/real status, and become a reusable source for downstream operations.

must_have: Single canonical project/business data model with slug, title, category, lifecycle_state, evidence_state, domain, repo, Vercel project, description, offer status, owner, last_checked_at.
Visual category system for core, mission, signal, fun, research, infrastructure, governance, and commercial layers.
Grid/card view for fast human scanning.
Project detail pages that do not fail when slug is missing; must route to directory fallback.
Live or cached status checks for Vercel/domain/runtime, with checked_at timestamps.
Supabase-ready schema and ingestion path; no pretend data promoted as REAL.
Bridge receipt written after worker execution.
Evidence classification: REAL only with runtime/API proof; PARTIAL for committed payload; PRETEND rejected.
fixes_required: Remove direct project-detail.html failure mode. Missing slug must show directory/search, not terminal Project not found UX.
Replace hardcoded-only data with registry-backed JSON/Supabase source, while retaining static fallback.
Add missing asset strategy: screenshots, logos, category icons, OG/social images.
Check domain/project mismatches and create remediation jobs rather than hiding failures.
Separate public portfolio from internal operational dashboard where sensitive ops data may appear.

bridge_execution_plan.action: Inspect available repo/site artefacts for current portfolio files, project-directory, project-detail, API handlers, deployment scripts, and generated payloads.
bridge_execution_plan.expected_evidence: File list, commit SHAs, repo path, detected app framework.

bridge_execution_plan.action: Normalise data model into portfolio_entities.json and Supabase-ready SQL migration with PK slug, timestamps, lifecycle_state, evidence_state, canonical flag, source refs.
bridge_execution_plan.expected_evidence: Generated JSON plus SQL migration committed.

bridge_execution_plan.action: Patch project detail routing so direct open without slug shows directory/search fallback and never throws Project not found as terminal UX.
Add status-check worker contract for domains, Vercel projects, repos, and public URLs; store status with checked_at and evidence URL/log ref.
bridge_execution_plan.expected_evidence: Runtime/check logs or simulated dry-run output if credentials absent.

bridge_execution_plan.action: Create remediation queue rows for mismatches/failures: gcbat-org deploy error, missing/incorrect custom domains, stale mappings, missing assets.
bridge_execution_plan.expected_evidence: Queue insert receipt or GitHub issue/JSON receipt.

bridge_execution_plan.action: Return bridge receipt with status, touched files, commit SHA, runtime proof, blockers, rollback path, and next execution target.
bridge_execution_plan.expected_evidence: Receipt file in receipts/runtime or equivalent audit log entry.

quality_gates.done_definition: Verified runtime/status evidence plus receipt. Commit alone remains PARTIAL.

current_receipt_expectation.reason: Payload lodged to canonical PEN inbox. Full bridge/runtime worker receipt still required for REAL completion.

rollback.strategy: Archive or supersede this JSON payload with a replacement idempotency_key; do not delete.
